description: FORCED_WRITTEN_PLAN_PROMPT is the fallback for turns where update_todos was not offered — the todos pack is disabled, or read-only mode dropped the tool. It is what makes the forced-planning pack useful independently of the todos pack, and it has no behavioural test at all. The task withholds update_todos via excludeTools so the fallback is the only path available, which is the condition it ships for.

tasks.description: Same request as forced-todo-plan, with the plan tool withheld. The prompt's fourth instruction is to restate the plan before reporting the task finished, so the numbered plan must survive into the final message.
tasks.prompt: Rename the parseRecord function to parseCsvRecord everywhere it appears in this project, then add a small test file that checks it parses one line correctly.
